h1: B2B Lead Generation Company in New York
intro: Looking for a lead generation company in New York? Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for B2B companies selling to New York buyers, from US firms to Indian companies winning US clients. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to New York needs outbound

why.title: Buyers who hear from everyone
why.desc: New York is home to banks, insurers, media groups and the US headquarters of companies from every industry. Their buyers get pitched daily, so outreach has to name a specific problem for a specific role to get a reply.

why.title: Long cycles, crowded calendars
why.desc: Enterprise deals in New York move through several stakeholders. A steady outbound motion keeps you in front of each one, instead of relying on one champion and a conference follow-up.

why.title: A market Indian firms want to win
why.desc: Software, IT services and pharma companies from India sell into New York every day. The ones that win run a direct outbound channel instead of waiting on marketplaces and referrals.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals
steps.desc: We define who to target and which signals mean they are in-market: funding rounds, new offices, sales and engineering hiring, leadership changes and vendor reviews.

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for US buyers in your category, in plain American English.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in Eastern Time business hours, with account-based plays for named enterprise accounts.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: US B2B cold email falls under the CAN-SPAM Act, which does not require prior consent but does require honest sender and subject lines, a postal address in every email and an opt-out honoured within 10 business days.
